metadata.settling_criterion: Compare complete-cycle mean, amplitude and phase; select settled cycles from measured noise and repeatability.
metadata.settings_status: Initial safety pilot; no temperature protection changed. No device action performed.
metadata.drive_equation: u = Ua_pwm + Ub_pwm*sin(phase_rad); no feedback, lookup or cooling multiplier
metadata.duration_note: Planning budget only. Inspect the first excursion; stop if the software cutoff is approached. Fixed duration does not certify settling.
metadata.start_note: Begin zero-centered diagnostics near measured room temperature. Record room temperature independently.
metadata.protocol: Current handout: begin near measured room temperature at period 300 s, Ua=0 and initial Ub=50. Reduce Ub if cutoff is approached; preserve existing safety limits. Keep the selected safe amplitude fixed for 300, 200 and 100 s.
metadata.supersedes: Earlier +/-100 PWM protocol for new matched raw-PWM trials; preserve earlier records with their original settings.
